name: The binding of sacred and corrupt
summary: At Darion's runeforge, the hammer is laid with Primordial Saronite and the acidic blood of the plague abominations Rotface and Festergut. Fire takes the components into itself. From sacred memory and corruption bound together, Darion shapes Shadow's Edge, an axe with power not yet its own. He places it in the seeker's hands and leaves the next work to the one who must carry it.
